exposure: pharmacist intervention program to improve guideline adherence for post-cesarean thromboprophylaxis
pharmacist intervention program to improve guideline adherence
outcome: rate of adherence to guidelines for post-cesarean thromboprophylaxis
thromboprophylaxis dose according to body weight
cohort: 102 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section
finding: A pharmacist intervention program significantly improved guideline adherence for post-cesarean thromboprophylaxis, including dosing calculations based on body weight and duration of therapy.
mod_finding: The most common risk factor of venous thromboembolism (VTE) is cesarean section.
